body: Sulit move ngayon is gap-check, hindi shopping spree. Since SCS is voluntary and wala pang evidence na major buyers are broadly requiring a rating, map your existing IT controls against the published requirements first. That can reveal whether the real gap is policy, evidence, training or tooling. Buying a new security product before knowing the gap risks paying for something that may not improve the eventual rating or procurement position.

claims.text: A control-gap assessment before purchasing new cybersecurity products is likely to reduce unnecessary spending while SCS adoption requirements remain unsettled.
claims.basis: Practical inference from the target article's established facts that SCS is voluntary and does not require a specific product.
